{{Quote|We don't know anything. We were promised transport offworld that's all.|The refugee to CT-9904|<ref name="Replacements" />}}
A '''human male refugee''' was promised [[transport]] off the [[planet]] [[Onderon]] by [[Saw Gerrera]]'s [[Partisans]]. When [[Crosshair|CT-9904]]'s [[Elite Squad|elite squad]] [[Mission to Onderon (Elite Squad)|hunted down]] and destroyed the Partisans camp, he asked the refugees for information. The refugee told him he that he had no information. Before CT-9904 could [[Death|execute]] the refugees, [[ES-01]] stopped him from doing so. After CT-9904 [[Death|killed]] ES-01, he ordered the other [[soldier]]s from the squad to execute the refugees. They complied, executing the Onderonian refugee and all the others.<ref name="Replacements" />
